bio.text: Inga Willis was elected to the Georgia House of Representatives in 2022 and represents District 55, which includes portions of Fulton County.
An Atlanta native, Willis founded Mogul Group Consultants in 2004 and earlier was fundraising manager for Shirley Franklin's 2004 mayoral campaign and marketing director for the Jimmy Carter Center.
Willis holds a Bachelor of Arts in Communications from Howard University; the legislature biography says she is a consultant with EdFarm, a program launched by the Propel Center.
